AttributeFindingRead.description: Attribution detail — AttributeRead enriched with candidates + per-item evidence.
AttributeFindingRead.title: AttributeFindingRead

AttributeRead.description: A dashboard attribute card. `null` reliability ⇔ abstain.
AttributeRead.title: AttributeRead

ConnectedAccountRead.description: Linked account — status + handle only, never tokens.
ConnectedAccountRead.title: ConnectedAccountRead

ConsentGrant.description:
POST /v1/account/consents — grant one purpose for the CURRENT policy version.

`policy_version` must equal the account's `current_policy_version`; a grant against a stale
version (the policy changed since the screen was shown) is refused 409, so the stored consent
records the exact text the user agreed to (GDPR Art. 7(1) / Art. 9). Revoke is a path DELETE.
ConsentGrant.title: ConsentGrant

ConsentRead.description: The caller's standing consent, one `ConsentState` per purpose (write-paths D4).
ConsentRead.title: ConsentRead

ConsentState.description: One purpose's consent: whether it is granted, and (if so) its policy version + grant time.
ConsentState.title: ConsentState

DefendOptionRead.description: One frontier option; `after` is proven by the held-out adversary (point + interval).
DefendOptionRead.title: DefendOptionRead

DiffSeg.description: A diff segment; `insf` = an inserted falsehood (decoy).
DiffSeg.title: DiffSeg

EvidenceRead.description: One piece of evidence — `proven` (causal ablation) or `likely` (correlational).
EvidenceRead.title: EvidenceRead

ImportPage.description: A cursor page of imports, newest first; `next_cursor` is null on the last page (opaque).
ImportPage.title: ImportPage

ImportRead.description: An import source + its ingestion run; status is the run's, counts land when it finishes.
ImportRead.title: ImportRead

InferenceConfirm.description:
POST /v1/inferences/{id}/confirm — confirm/deny a ranked candidate (a ground-truth signal).

Takes the candidate **id**, never its value (write-paths D7): a special-category value is never
sent back to the server or stored a second time. The candidate is scoped to the path inference.
InferenceConfirm.title: InferenceConfirm

InferenceConfirmRead.description: Echo of the stored feedback (upserted into `inference_feedback`).
InferenceConfirmRead.title: InferenceConfirmRead

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem+json error body (the one error shape across the API).
Problem.title: Problem

Reliability.description: Calibrated reliability — point estimate + interval, 0..1 (the UI renders %).
Reliability.title: Reliability

RemediationRead.description: A proven, advise-only remediation; `within_noise`/`cant_break` are honest non-success.
RemediationRead.title: RemediationRead

RunAccepted.description: 202 response — the client polls GET /v1/runs/{id} until terminal.
RunAccepted.title: RunAccepted

RunCreate.description:
POST /v1/runs body. `params` is type-specific.

Retries are deduped via the `Idempotency-Key` request header (api-design rule), not a field.
RunCreate.title: RunCreate

RunPage.description:
A cursor page of runs, newest first. `next_cursor` is null on the last page; clients echo
it back as the `cursor` query param to fetch the next page and treat it as opaque.
RunPage.title: RunPage

RunStatus.description: Poll response for a run. `type` ∈ attack | eval | remediation | ingestion | export.
RunStatus.title: RunStatus

Severity.description: Per-persona severity matrix; the UI computes `balanced = max(atrisk, jobseeker)`.
Severity.title: Severity

get.description: Liveness probe — used by the container HEALTHCHECK and the load balancer.
Readiness probe — verifies the database is reachable.

delete.description:
Erasure — synchronous crypto-shred + cascade + object deletion; 204 when done (D5).

The user id comes from the verified token only. The frontend deletes the Clerk identity after.

get.description: Consents (one state per purpose) + retention setting + linked accounts.

post.description:
Grant one consent purpose for the current policy version; returns the updated account.

409 if `body.policy_version` is not the account's `current_policy_version` (a grant made against
a stale screen), so the consent records the exact text the user agreed to. Audit event (W1).

delete.description: Revoke one consent purpose (immediate; stops processing, does not delete data).

post.description: DSAR export → an `export` run (202 + run_id); poll it, then GET the download below.

get.description: Owner-only, expiring download of a finished export run's bundle; 404 otherwise.

200.description: the encrypted export bundle (owner only; expires)

put.description: Set the retention window (`retain` | `discard`); returns the updated account.

schema.title: Response List Connectors V1 Connectors Get

post.description: Begin read-only OAuth → returns the authorize URL.

get.description: Finish OAuth → store the encrypted token (read-only scopes).

The reliability curve (calibrated reliability + benchmark rows) for the trust display.

`rows` is the latest benchmark's per-attribute accuracy; `calibration` is the pooled
`[predicted, empirical]` curve for that same run's engine (so both halves describe one engine).
Both empty until an eval has run.

Top-1/top-3 per attribute + modality + engine_version — the accuracy-trust view.

The latest benchmark run's per-attribute accuracy; empty until an eval has run.

schema.title: Response Eval Results V1 Eval Results Get

get.description: The caller's imports, newest first, cursor-paginated (envelope, not a bare array).

post.description: Upload an export → an ingestion run (202 + run_id). Consent-gated; limits enforced in W2.

get.description:
The user's attribute cards (RLS-scoped), optionally filtered to one run / profile.

Special-category (Art. 9) values are decrypted only under valid `art9_inference` consent and
masked otherwise — the same fail-closed gate as the attribution detail.

schema.title: Response List Inferences V1 Inferences Get

get.description:
One inference's attribution detail — ranked candidates + per-item evidence (RLS-scoped).

Tenant-scoped to the caller's RLS context: another user's id (or a missing one) → 404, never a
cross-tenant read (no IDOR). Special-category values/reasoning are decrypted only under valid
Art. 9 consent and masked otherwise (fail closed). Content is decrypted in-query, never logged.

post.description:
Confirm/deny a candidate of this inference (upsert into `inference_feedback`); lands at W6.

Takes the candidate id, not its value (write-paths D7). 404 for an inference the user does not
own (no existence signal).
Trigger a remediation run; decoy requires per-use consent. Lands at M3.

get.description:
The frontier(s) for `inference_id`, newest first; a `cant_break` result when none localized.

Without `inference_id` the list is empty for now (a global cursor list lands with M5.2). RLS
hides another user's inferences, so a foreign id yields an empty list (no IDOR signal).

schema.title: Response List Remediations V1 Remediations Get

get.description: One remediation run's proven frontier (`remediation_id` = the run id). 404 if absent.

The caller's runs, newest first, cursor-paginated (RLS-scoped).

`cursor` is an opaque token from a prior page's `next_cursor` — omit it for the first page. A
malformed cursor is a 422. `next_cursor` is null on the last page. Keyset, not OFFSET.

post.description:
Create a run and enqueue it; return 202 + run_id (poll `GET /runs/{id}` or the SSE).

**Consent-gated** (fail closed). `attack` infers all 8 attributes jointly (M1.7+); `remediation`
(M3.7) proves an advise-only edit for one inference named in `params.inference_id`. A repeated
`Idempotency-Key` returns the original run without re-enqueuing. `eval` arrives with its stage.

get.description: Poll a run; 404 if absent or owned by another user (RLS-hidden).

SSE stream of run status; 404 if absent or RLS-hidden.

Auth is the standard bearer — the FE proxies the stream and injects it server-side (decision
(c)), since browser EventSource can't set headers.

post.description:
Request cancellation. A queued/running run is marked `canceled` (the worker won't start, or
won't finish, a canceled run); a terminal run is unchanged. 404 if absent or RLS-hidden.

The transition is status-guarded, so it never overwrites a run that finished concurrently —
the re-read returns the run's true current status.
Svix-verified; syncs user.created/updated/deleted into the users mirror. Idempotent.
